verdict.rationale: Stripe's Radar feature explicitly uses AI algorithms to score fraud risk on transactions/customers directly in the product, and Recovery analytics surfaces payment failure/recovery insights in the Dashboard, both qualifying as in-product data insights. However, there is no evidence of a broader AI-generated insights/suggestions layer (e.g., a natural-language analytics assistant or dashboard copilot) beyond fraud risk scoring. Missing for 10: evidence of a general-purpose AI insights/copilot feature across broader business data, and independent/hands-on corroboration of Radar's AI insight quality.
